notes.childcare: Nothing new this week worth your time for an 18-month-old.

items.title: Gold firms as dollar, yields and oil retreat before CPI
items.summary: Spot gold rose 0.39% to $4,186.90 on 13 October as the dollar index eased toward 102.3, the 10-year Treasury yield slipped to about 5.19% and oil fell about 2%, ahead of Wednesday's US inflation data.

items.title: Lãi suất cao đẩy thị trường nhà ở sang cuộc đua “khả năng sở hữu”
items.summary: Theo Viện DXS-FERI, lãi suất vay mua nhà thả nổi quanh 13-15%/năm khiến chủ đầu tư cạnh tranh bằng phương án thanh toán và hỗ trợ tài chính thay vì giá bán. 76% người mua cần từ 3 tháng trở lên để ra quyết định.

items.title: Spotify more than doubled monthly code changes as AI accelerated development
items.summary: AI-assisted development raised Spotify's monthly merged changes from about 8,100 to 17,000 year over year, prompting a review of quality and reliability controls across nearly 3,000 services. After a June pipeline incident, it added monitoring, fixed a scheduler bug and increased capacity.

items.title: Context Language Models: self-managing context to improve performance and cut compute
items.summary: Researchers from Meta, MIT and the University of Washington propose models that edit their own context instead of relying on fixed summarization or retrieval. On BrowseComp-Plus, zero-shot CLMs reported 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs.

items.title: What does it really mean to program with AI? A conversation with Joy Ebertz
items.summary: Michael Stiefel and Joy Ebertz discuss how AI-assisted coding changes the work of architects and developers: monolith versus microservices trade-offs, the need for precise requirements and tests, and how juniors learn when AI does the tasks they once learned from.
